subject: PyStan 2.4.0.1 has OS X wheels. Testers needed.

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: PyStan 2.4.0.1 has OS X wheels. Testers needed.
parts:
Hi,

PyStan 2.4.0.1 is available and now comes, for OS X 10.5 users, as a binary
package called a "wheel" [1]. In theory, this means installation on OS X will be
very rapid as you need not compile the stan library.

If you are an OS X 10.5 user comfortable with Python---and you have a recent
version of the package `pip` installed that supports wheels---please consider
testing the 2.4.0.1 wheel out and reporting any problems on the PyStan issue
tracker [2].

It should be as easy as `pip install pystan`.

Thanks,

Allen

[1] http://legacy.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0427/
[2] https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan

messages.subject: PyStan 2.4.0.1 new wheels for OS X, testers?
parts:
Hi,

PyStan 2.4.0.1 wheels for OS X 10.9 are up and should be installable with ``pip
install pystan`` (you'll need a recent version of pip to use the wheels).
Reports of success and of bugs are welcome.

Best,

-a
